part.Name: Description
part.Short: Smooth spall from the world's slow grinding, come down at last.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: A fist of the ceiling, freshly parted from it.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: A volume of the ceiling lies where it landed, broken past any use but blocking the way all the same.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: A porous stone sweating brine. The sea it remembers is long gone.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Slick films of ooze pearl across this stone and never quite dry.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Stone drawn to an argument. Its point has never once been dulled by use.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: A cloudy crystal chipped from a brine seam. The thirsty earth kept a little water locked inside.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: No two people describe it the same way, and neither do the same two people.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: A slab too broken to stand and too stubborn to lie flat.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Bands of blue mineral whorl in toward a middle that the eye keeps missing.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: A heavy stone wrapped in heavier air. Sleep pools in its shadow.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: A stone that never agreed to stop. Thrown, it keeps the argument going off everything nearby.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: A stone with an argument sealed inside, waiting on the last word.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: A rind of mold holds this stone together more than the stone does. Its spores wait on any excuse.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: A spear of ceiling-grown stone, snapped at the root and honed by the fall.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: A tooth of the floor, grown drip by patient drip and snapped loose all at once.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: A stone cocooned in dusty silk. The strands remember their business.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: A stone bled through with old iron. What it touches, it teaches to decay.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: A dark tablet with nothing written on it, which is somehow worse.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Veins of some clinging mineral wrap this stone like cords that never learned to let go.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: A knot of stone spines packed too tight to stay together forever.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Old fires pressed to a brick by the patient weight of the ceiling. It crumbles at the edges into breathless gray.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: A shelf of the deep ceiling, standing now where it fell, load-bearing for nothing.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Veins of copper and older metals braid through this stone. They still carry a charge.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: It came down glowing and has not forgiven the fall.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Cold seeps from this stone as though winter were stored in it under pressure.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: A stone shot through with magnetized iron, humming at frequencies machines find upsetting.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: A stone warped around a hollow that whistles when it moves. Whatever air it swallowed last comes out changed.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: A shard of glass so black it unlights the air around it. Looking at it feels like a held breath.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: A stone losing an argument with itself. What it sheds eats the floor.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: A stone that was somewhere else a moment ago. Whatever it strikes goes to find out where.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: An ape rendered in stone by no sculptor anyone can name. It moves like it remembers being one or the other.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: A baboon no taller than a knee, carved by patient hands and impatient to be moving. It sizes up everything as either a threat or a throw.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: A stone still ringing from a speed it once knew. Thrown, it remembers the way.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: A vent of restless stone. Every so often the earth below clears its throat.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: A stone that invites second thoughts, at length, about everything you know how to do.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: A stone latticed in perfect right angles. Reality straightens up around it, embarrassed.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Warm to the touch, and pleased about something. Best hurled at strangers.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: A stone that refuses on your behalf.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: A stone that is mostly elsewhere. It can be held, with concentration.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Countless small spirals argue over which way this stone turns. Sometimes the argument spills out.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: A hairline parting in the floor, wide enough to have opinions about weight.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: The collapse kept going. Below is only more below.

part.Name: StairsDown
part.PullMessage: You plunge through the broken floor!

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Iron with a grudge. Everything metal is owed to it, and it collects.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Its edges refuse to commit. Whatever it strikes becomes similarly unsure how many of it there are.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: A stone pocked like old bone and faintly warm. It knows what it wants.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Veins of metal braid denser in the deep strata, and the charge they carry has had ages to build. It does not wait to be asked.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: A knuckle of the world's own furnace, still deciding whether to cool.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Winter under pressure, condensed until it aches. The cold gets into the hand that holds it.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: A stone dissolving itself out of spite. Everything it touches is invited.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Loose lightning with nowhere to be.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: A stone lit from within by a steady green light. It offers no opinion on what the light is.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: A stone lit from within by a steady green light. It offers no opinion on what the light is.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Rock brought low, ground patient and fine. It keeps whatever the stone knew.

part.Short: Rock brought low, ground patient and fine. It keeps whatever the stone knew.
